scope.purpose: metadata-only provenance comparison of the published P06 past/diagonal states and retained TRR-0006 enriched positionwise/causal states
scope.read_boundary: Only JSON/Markdown/source metadata and hashes were read. No activation, token-id, checkpoint tensor, evaluator answer, or truth payload was opened for this comparison.
scope.causal_interpretation: These differences document non-equivalence of fit provenance; they do not attribute any prediction difference to one factor.

shared_public_inference_contract.comparison_note: The published prediction boundary is shared for P06 and TRR-0006 replay. The fit receipts do not independently expose every training autocast/kernel setting; no stronger training-precision equivalence is claimed.

pairwise_differences.trr0006: identity W, zero b, s=3.0; qkv seed 4005

pairwise_differences.trr0006: unweighted mean of per-style post-BOS token accuracies over 3133 H192 rows (24 Alpaca + 24 Pile validation records), earliest maximum every 100 steps including step 0

pairwise_differences.p06: 3000 steps, batch 8, 512 draws/update, AdamW lr 1e-3 wd 0, clip 1, cosine schedule; schedule seed 6106/6107; selected steps past 1700/2000 and diagonal 1700/900
pairwise_differences.trr0006: 3000 steps, batch 8, 512 draws/update, AdamW lr 1e-3 wd 0, clip 1, cosine schedule; schedule seed 4005; selected steps diagonal 1600 and repaired causal 1900
pairwise_differences.exact_difference: optimizer family, budget, and nominal draw count match; sampler seed/schedule and selected checkpoint differ.

pairwise_differences.p06: cosine Q/K normalization with scale 4.0 for both masks; diagonal one-key path makes score normalization behaviorally inert
pairwise_differences.trr0006: retained diagonal kept legacy dot-product; repaired causal uses cosine_scale4; old causal dot-product development state is not the retained repaired state
pairwise_differences.exact_difference: P06 past and repaired old causal share the declared cosine-scale rule; P06 diagonal and old diagonal have different declared score rules but one-key forward behavior is equivalent under the published mathematical contract.

pairwise_differences.p06: P06 plan declares F32 layer norm/model/logits, F32 output L2, shared F32 E; published boundary consumes BF16 H, bool masks, no autocast
pairwise_differences.trr0006: published prediction registration declares BF16 H input, F32 decoder/logits and E, bool masks, no autocast, float32 matmul precision highest
pairwise_differences.exact_difference: prediction-time contract is shared/bound; training-time autocast/kernel equivalence is not independently proven by these receipts.

known_exactly: All state file hashes, selected steps, fit source-ID/mask hashes, source commits, geometry declarations, initial affine declarations, seeds, optimizer budgets, score rules, and selection metrics listed above are present in published metadata.
The retained causal state is the post-amendment cosine_scale4 state selected at step 1900; the retained diagonal state is the un-repaired original state selected at step 1600.
TRR-0006 published replay is H128 at prediction time even though the retained states were fit against full H192 geometry.
The old and P06 fit-support hashes differ; equal record counts do not imply equal records or equal valid-position support.
unresolved_or_not_claimed: No payload was opened here, so tensor-level equality of W, b, s, Q/K/V, masks, or observations was not tested.
The metadata does not prove an exact training-time autocast/kernel equivalence between P06 and the old fit runs beyond the published prediction boundary.
The old fit and P06 fit source-ID sets were not intersected by opening source records; no overlap/disjointness count is claimed.
The provenance comparison alone cannot attribute a P07 score difference to crop, initialization, mask, selection metric, attention normalization, or any single factor.
The old qknorm amendment explicitly preserves old diagonal states and does not retroactively refit them under cosine normalization.
